scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with people walking around, surrounded by buildings and trees. The sky is clear and blue. There are several people walking in different directions, some carrying bags or backpacks. A few benches and trash cans are scattered along the sidewalk. In the distance, there are tall buildings and trees lining the street. The street itself is made of concrete and has a smooth surface. There are no cars or other vehicles visible. The atmosphere is lively and bustling, with people going about their daily business.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings in the background are mostly white or light-colored, with some having ornate facades. One building has a large stone statue on top. Some have balconies or terraces. The buildings appear to be well-maintained but show signs of wear and tear. There are also some trees and bushes along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.materials: The ground is made of concrete, with some areas showing signs of wear and tear. There are no notable materials or textures visible.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans scattered along the sidewalk. Some are placed near the edge of the street, while others are further back.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees and bushes along the sidewalk, as well as some potted plants. The trees are relatively small and sparse.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs visible, including street signs, directional signs, and advertisements. Some of the signs are illegible.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking in various directions, some alone and others in groups. Some are looking at their phones or talking to each other.
scene_analysis.as_resident: A few people are sitting on benches or standing in small groups, chatting or taking photos. Others are walking quickly, either alone or in pairs.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: People are walking to work or school. Some are carrying briefcases or backpacks.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: There are several tourists taking photos or admiring the scenery. Some are looking at maps or brochures.
scene_analysis.as_student: Students are walking to class or studying. Some are carrying books or laptops.
